Sandbox_BlueZone_Style_tooltip: How the zone looks: the wall (Viewpoint 1st/3rd person), the map and minimap colour, the screen tint outside the zone and the HUD timer colour. Damage and timing stay the same.
Sandbox_BlueZone_WaitScale_tooltip: Multiplies every phase wait (white circle shown, wall still). For looting time. 1.0 = about 74 min per round, 1.6 = about 2 hours. 0.1 for testing.
Sandbox_BlueZone_ShrinkScale_tooltip: Multiplies every phase shrink (wall moving) time. For travel speed. Lower = faster wall. 0.1 for testing.
Sandbox_BlueZone_DamageScale_tooltip: Multiplies damage per second outside the containment zone. Base 0.4 to 11 per second by phase (out of 100 health). 0 = no damage.
Sandbox_BlueZone_FirstRadius_tooltip: Radius of the phase 1 white circle. The starting blue circle has the same center and covers the whole area. Later phases shrink by 0.65 then 0.5. Default 1500 is for 20-30 players. Clamped to half of the area short side.
Sandbox_BlueZone_AvoidEmptyNW_tooltip: On: safe zones (white circles) are re-rolled so they do not land on the empty north-west of the vanilla map (cells x<45 and y<18, plus the triangle above the line (45,3)-(58,0)). The centre must be outside it and less than half of the circle may be in it. Same area as the HALO Drop option of the same name. Turn off on other maps.
Sandbox_BlueZone_AreaX1_tooltip: West edge of the zone area (world tiles). The starting blue circle covers this rectangle and the phase 1 white circle fits inside it.
Sandbox_BlueZone_AreaY1_tooltip: North edge of the zone area (world tiles).
Sandbox_BlueZone_AreaX2_tooltip: East edge of the zone area (world tiles).
Sandbox_BlueZone_AreaY2_tooltip: South edge of the zone area (world tiles).
Sandbox_BlueZone_ExemptX1_tooltip: Players inside this rectangle take no containment damage (lobby). Applied only when X2 > X1 and Y2 > Y1. Default is the oil rig.
Sandbox_BlueZone_ExemptY1_tooltip: North edge of the exempt area (world tiles).
Sandbox_BlueZone_ExemptX2_tooltip: East edge of the exempt area (world tiles).
Sandbox_BlueZone_ExemptY2_tooltip: South edge of the exempt area (world tiles). Height is ignored.
